status: Exploratory optimizer family control. Frozen geometry-only amendment before reference inspection or fitting.
hyperparameter_selection: None; fixed budget. Validation diagnostic only.
physics_loss: mean complex squared PDE V + PDE I + driven interface /4 + short
data_loss: mean |V-Vref|^2+|I-Iref|^2, same geometry/xi stream and architecture
reference_cost: Reference fields generated on demand in both runs for shared diagnostic logging; included in training wall time and timed separately, never added twice
no_test_training: No reference labels or residual points from test/validation geometries; blocked d excluded from training
analytic_factor: R_s(a,d)=exp(-2 gamma a)*r_s(d); phase separation depends only on d

split_amendment.reason: Original 336 new blocked geometries exceeded the 257 packing upper bound. Changed counts before fitting, no threshold or separation change.

optimizer_control.objective: mean |V_xi + gamma*d*I|^2 + mean |I_xi + gamma*d*V|^2 + mean |V(0)+(1+z)*I(0)-2|^2/4 + mean |V(1)|^2
optimizer_control.early_convergence_rule: If L-BFGS terminates early, report an incomplete 1200-call comparison and stop Adam at that attained call count. No successful matched-1200 claim.
optimizer_control.cap_rule: Count all full closure evaluations. Intercept completed line-search returns to record accepted x+t*d. On budget exception restore last accepted vector.
optimizer_control.gate_decision_population: All clear validation designs, matching the retained representability gate; blocked clear decisions also reported separately.
optimizer_control.repeat_rule: Run seeds 1 and 2 unchanged only if either seed 0 arm passes the combined numerical validation gate. No repeat based on holdout.
optimizer_control.scope: Optimizer family conditional on shared full-batch continuation, not full-batch versus old minibatch. Equal objective-gradient calls are not equal runtime. Prior inspected tests make this exploratory.
